name: Cisco PSIRT CSAF 2.0 advisories (www.cisco.com/.well-known/csaf)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering; CSAF trusted provider of its own product advisories (A8 BR2, P354).
tier_reviewer: batch p3-G08-1 (council-1 A8 definitions; chair files P191/P354/P355)

reliability.justification: Vendor PSIRT advisories about the vendor's own products (fixed releases, affected versions): the authoritative source for them.

csaf.title: Cisco CSAF 2.0 provider-metadata, directory changes.csv and advisory documents (+ .sha512)

terms.quote: A standalone copy or paraphrase of the text of this document that omits the distribution URL is an uncontrolled copy and may lack important information or contain factual errors.

csaf.notes: P354: synced out of band into the local CSAF index (csaf_advisories); documents only from www.cisco.com (https), <= 2,000 per sync, <= 5 MB each, .sha512 checked (.sha256 is a 404 page). Reports keep the distribution URL with every excerpt (Cisco legal disclaimer). www.cisco.com sets tracking cookies on every answer: the core never stores or replays cookies.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G08-1 (P354). Only the CSAF tree is fetched; canonical advisory pages (sec.cloudapps.cisco.com) are links only.
